description: On-chain lifecycle for autonomous AI agents on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.30). An admin initialises a registry PDA (lab patch: upstream shipped no initialize instruction); owners register agent PDAs, an oracle commits task results, and the owner can update status or deactivate.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration on the Blockchains/AgentX-Solana-Deploy fork. The initialize_registry instruction is a lab patch because upstream has no way to create the registry PDA that every other instruction requires. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; the patch is offered upstream as an ordinary pull request and acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (initialize_registry, register_agent, update_state, execute_task, deactivate_agent)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/agentx/
QA: devnet proof of registry init, agent registration, activation, a verified task, deactivate, and rejected inactive/deactivated paths
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Add a devnet fixture that creates an AGX mint and reward vault and exercises claim_reward
